title: Track 8: Declarative Key-Chord DSL, Transient Sub-Modes, Contextual Hint Bar & AST Codegen
description: Build a two-tier Odin UI navigation DSL: (Tier 1) runtime Vim/TUI chord parser, multi-key chord & transient widget sub-modes, core:reflect struct-tag action registration unifying Keymap_Table + Command_Palette + contextual breadcrumb/shortcut bars, and (Tier 2) an optional core:odin/ast CLI generator (tools/bifrost_gen) for static @(ui_scope)/@(ui_action) dispatch tables.
